description: Check a Korean fixed overtime allowance (포괄임금 고정 연장수당) against the statutory premium for the hours actually worked. Hourly = pay excluding the fixed allowance ÷ monthly hours; shortfall per month × up to 36 months (3-year wage claim limitation). Also flags pay below the 2026 minimum wage (10,320 KRW/h) and how many overtime hours the fixed allowance covers.

basePay.description: Monthly base pay and fixed allowances, excluding the fixed overtime allowance (KRW)

fixedOtPay.description: Fixed overtime / night / holiday allowance in the monthly pay (KRW)
